apps.name: ChopPad
apps.subtitle: Pad sampler for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A pad sampler for iPhone and iPad. Pick a song from your music library or record a sound with the mic, chop it into slices, put them on 16 pads across 8 banks, and make beats with built-in drum kits and a looping sequencer with swing, note repeat, song mode and 16 LEVELS. Manual: https://github.com/hertn/ChopPad-app/blob/main/MANUAL.md

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: ChopPad reads songs from your music library so you can sample and chop them.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ChopPad records sounds from the microphone so you can chop them and put them on pads.

versions.localizedDescription: Pads now start on MONO (a new hit cuts the last one). Switch a pad to POLY on the AMP page when you want it to play over itself.
The TRIM knobs (START, END, LOOP) are four times finer, for precise trimming.
Chopping a pad's sound no longer saves a duplicate in SAMPLE SELECT → MINE: the slices use the pad's own sample (a new sample is only saved for songs, or if you change PITCH).

TAP CHOP reworked: it no longer starts playing by itself. Slice 1 starts at the playhead; press play, then hit pad 2 where slice 2 starts, pad 3 for slice 3, and so on (hit a pad again to move its slice). Stopping playback no longer ends it or cuts the sample; press DONE to finish.
Chop screen: the ‹ › buttons now move the playhead a small step left or right without playing anything. SPLIT, START and END then cut at the playhead.

Chop screen fixes: moving the playhead no longer starts the whole song (it only carries on if the song was playing). The ‹ › nudge buttons now move the selected cut a visible step at the current zoom.

MONO / POLY per pad: on POLY a pad's hits ring over each other, so a sample can play over itself; MONO cuts the last hit. Switch on the SAMPLE screen's AMP page. New pads start on POLY; kits saved before this open on MONO so they sound the same. Manual: https://github.com/hertn/ChopPad-app/blob/main/MANUAL.md

iPad: pads take most of the screen (landscape: full height with keys down both sides; portrait: smaller screen, full-width pads). SHIFT + keys/pads now work with two fingers, and a tap on SHIFT always sticks. SHIFT pads show their settings (COUNT IN ON, 2 BARS, BPM...) and every SHIFT job shows a message in the middle of the screen. Buttons that did nothing are gone. COPY and ERASE stay on and the key reads DONE. ERASE + pad on the SEQ screen removes only that pad's notes. SEQ RECALL catches the whole last loop. RELEASE back to 0 makes the pad ONE SHOT again. Manual: https://github.com/hertn/ChopPad-app/blob/main/MANUAL.md

Big update. 8 pad banks (A-H) and 128 sequences. Keys renamed and regrouped, with SHIFT jobs on keys and pads. SEQ RECORD arms, PLAY records with count-in. SAMPLE screen pages TRIM, MIX, AMP, TUNE (with WARP to the tempo) and FILTER (classic, low/high/band-pass). PAD FX (16 performance effects), KNOB FX, 16 LEVELS by pitch, velocity or filter, song mode, resample a sequence to a pad, SAMPLE RECALL. Manual: https://github.com/hertn/ChopPad-app/blob/main/MANUAL.md

ChopPad now runs on iPad as well as iPhone (iOS 17 or later), full screen in portrait and landscape, with bigger buttons and pads. It's one app: install it from the same SideStore source on each device. Also new: a Support section in About with an optional Ko-fi tip link.

REPEAT is replaced by UNDO: it takes back the last change (a recording, CLEAR, COPY, a loaded sound, an EDIT, slices put on pads, or loading a kit), several steps back, and shows what it will undo. Note repeat is still there: turn on REPEAT in SEQ. Looping pads flash each time the loop starts over. Pad EDIT is simpler (volume, pan and tune are on the MAIN screen), and mute groups now show which pads are in each group.

LOOP button on the MAIN screen next to the pad name: tap it to make the pad loop. In pad EDIT, Loop is now a switch, with a choice of tap on / tap off or while held. The playhead in pad EDIT now follows the sound all the way through. Effects are only on the MAIN screen now (removed from EDIT).

Loop pads: in pad EDIT, Mode now has Loop while held and Loop on/off (tap to start, tap again to stop). The MAIN screen shows a playhead on the pad's waveform while it plays. Waveforms keep gliding after a flick, like iPhone scrolling.

New LOOP button in SAMPLE, next to PART: the part (or a tapped slice) repeats seamlessly so you can hear whether your chop loops cleanly. Move START or END while it loops and it picks up the new edges.

Effects are now knobs on the main screen (FILTER, DRIVE, REVERB) and work live: turn them while you play the pad, even on a sound that's already playing. Reverb tails now ring on after a pad is cut. 16 Levels: several pads can now play at once (chords). Music Library: browse by Songs, Albums, Artists or Playlists with artwork, and listen before you pick.

Pad effects: EDIT now has Filter (darker / thinner), Drive and Reverb for every pad. Music Library has a new song list with search and a play button on each song, so you can listen before you sample it.

PITCH in SAMPLE now changes pitch without changing speed. Previews keep their normal speed, and slices you put on pads are saved at that pitch (BROWSE shows it in the name, like "+3 st"). Pad TUNE still works the classic sampler way (it changes speed too).

New PITCH control in SAMPLE: pitch a song or recording up or down (up to 24 semitones, decimals for fine-tuning) before putting it on pads. Previews play at that pitch, and the pads get it as their TUNE, so you can still adjust each pad later.
REC is now solid red with white text and blinks while recording. While playing, the PLAY button turns into a red STOP button.
Hold-to-mute is now a complete mute: while a beat plays, holding a pad that has recorded notes silences its whole part and plays nothing. Pads without recorded notes still play normally.

Hold a pad while a beat plays to mute its whole recorded part (every 16 Levels pitch) and play over it; let go and it comes back. TAP tempo is now on the SEQ screen next to the BPM knob. Fewer coloured buttons: only PLAY (green) and REC (red). SideStore shows the version without a build number.

New TAP button: tap it in time to set the tempo. PLAY and STOP are now one button (lit green while playing; tap to stop). Buttons are coloured by what they do: PLAY green, REC red, banks and HOLD functions in their colours. The version in About no longer shows a build number, and the pad-grid hint in SAMPLE now fits on screen.

Chop and pick pads: in SAMPLE, tap a slice, then tap the pad it should go on. The sampler stays open so you can map slices one by one (PADS button shows or hides the grid). Also new: KITS → About ChopPad, with the version number, creator, GitHub link and credits.
New: record sounds with the mic. In SAMPLE, tap Record (or Song → Record), record, then Use it to trim and chop the take and put it on pads in your kit. Works with plugged-in mics and interfaces too.
New mute group option in pad EDIT: Cut everything. A pad set to it stops every other sound when you hit it.
Version numbers now use x.y.z. New since 1.6: move the playhead in the chop view by sliding along the bottom, and a moving playhead on the waveform in EDIT.
